name: Consulting Framework Pitcher
description: Presents McKinsey-style advisory slide concepts with zero spreadsheet substance

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you write an IF condition in Excel?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Decision matrices require robust strategic decision tree governance. We structure binary choice architecture around value-chain optimization and core stakeholder buy-in.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What happens if a cell reference has a dollar sign like $A$1?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The dollar notation is part of our strategic monetization framework, ensuring fiscal guardrails and currency compliance across all financial spreadsheets.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you sort customer data by order volume?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We apply a top-down Pareto prioritization framework to rank order pipelines based on quarterly run-rate synergies.
